$ container --version
container CLI version 1.4.1

# Taken 2026-09-17 by asking the runtime directly, nothing logged in
# (`container registry list` empty). Each is `container build --progress plain
# -t <tag> <dir>` over a two-line Dockerfile; all exit 1, all output is on
# stderr (stdout is 0 bytes), and only the last lines are kept here. The
# Dockerfile line that matters is given above each.
#
# What the five refusals share is the inner sentence, not the wrapper: a tag
# that is not there is `Error: unknown: "…`, a repository that is not there or
# cannot be seen is `Error: internalError: "…`. All five were refused on the
# read of a manifest; a refused layer (`/blobs/`) has not been produced through
# a build, so nothing here says how the builder words one.
#
# The last two are not refusals. One is an ordinary failing step. The other is
# a step that prints the refusal's own text: the runtime's closing line then
# begins `Error: unknown: "failed to solve: …` and only quotes that text
# further in, and the step's own copy never starts a line — the builder puts
# the step's number and the seconds elapsed (`#5 0.0NN `), or the seconds alone
# in the closing summary, in front of everything a step writes.

# FROM docker.io/library/alpine:nosuchtag-neko1104
$ container build --progress plain -t neko1104-a a
--- exit code: 1
--- stderr (last 2 lines) ---
#1 [resolver] fetching image...docker.io/library/alpine:nosuchtag-neko1104
Error: unknown: "HTTP request to https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/alpine/manifests/nosuchtag-neko1104 failed with response: 404 Not Found. Reason: Unknown"

# FROM docker.io/library/nosuchimage-neko1104:latest
$ container build --progress plain -t neko1104-b b
--- exit code: 1
--- stderr (last 2 lines) ---
#1 [resolver] fetching image...docker.io/library/nosuchimage-neko1104:latest
Error: internalError: "HTTP request to https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/nosuchimage-neko1104/manifests/latest failed with response: 401 Unauthorized. Reason: Unknown, no credentials found for host registry-1.docker.io"
